text: A program manager is working in a motor automation company. The company is outsourcing its complex piece of work from a local vendor in the same city. This outsourcing has made the program manager to keep additional funds in reserve for the related work. As the vendor is new in the market, the program manager is a bit worried about the reliability of this vendor. According to the given scenario, this is an example of which type of risk?

An enterprise program management office has an effective PMIS (program management information system) for a program that is undertaken in an organization. This effective PMIS is a key element of which of the following?
Which of the following is the function of program governance?
choices: A. It describes evolving aspects of the program containing incremental benefits delivery.
B. It identifies the associated activities, processes, and systems required for the change driven by the realization of benefits.
C. It provides a formal declaration of the program benefits, the expected delivery, and the justification for the resources that will be expended for delivering it.
D. It helps the program team in determining if benefits achievement is occurring within the stated parameters.

text: Maria is a program manager for a new program that involves the development of a new interface for an existing time management system. She is planning to outsource services from an outside company to do the development work for the program. She has started working on the legal contract that will engage this company. Which of the following program management activities is Maria employing while doing so?
Stakeholder engagement is important for any organization and concerns which of the following?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: D. Ongoing support only at the program delivery phase

text: Who authorizes the program management team to utilize organizational resources for executing the program and linking the program to the organization's strategic objectives?
The benefits management plan should be used for which of the following?
choices: A. Defining how the resulting benefits and capabilities will be transitioned into an operational state to achieve benefits
B. Defining roles and responsibilities required to manage the benefits
C. Linking components outputs to the planned program outcomes
D. Recording program progress in the benefits register

text: In which program benefits management phase are the benefits metrics and framework developed?
Which of the following program artifacts needs to be assessed for potential revision when there is a significant change in the program master schedule?
Kate is evaluating the program component performance against the program success criteria. Who is responsible for establishing minimum acceptable criteria?
The program performance monitoring and controlling activities are performed by which of the following during delivery management?
choices: D. Both program- and project-level components

text: Sam is a program manager who is currently creating a stakeholder register. Which of the following items will you include in this register?
choices: B. Stakeholder's degree of support for the program
C. Stakeholder's ability to affect the program outcome or result
D. Stakeholder relationship to the program

text: Jack works as a program manager for the X-Tel program. The program management plan has been developed and the component program's end date has been finalized. During the program delivery phase, one of your stakeholders has requested you to add some new features to the component program but will not renegotiate the end date. To manage the additional changes in the component program, you have submitted the change request. Who among the following will be responsible for approving or rejecting the change request?
A program manager, John, needs information on the groups and individuals with an interest and involvement in a program. To which program document should the program manager refer?

A program manager wants to use a visual tool that organizes stakeholders according to the key criteria with which the program manager will be managing them during the program. Which of the following will help in accomplishing it?

A program manager who is managing an IT program has outsourced a third-party vendor for a program's component as the vendor has expertise on the related technology. Considering the third-party involvement, the manager is assessing and determining all risks for developing the business case of the program. The team identifies sources of change, such as the volatility of the enterprise environmental factors, the sensitivity of the proposed program's business case to changes in organizational strategy, and the possible frequency and magnitude of changes that may occur from components during the program delivery. Which program activity will take care of these actions?

Ana is managing a program for designer shirts in a global garment manufacturing company. This program requires interaction with key stakeholders, who are located globally at different locations. Once the program is finalized and the contract is signed, Ana along with her team will perform stakeholder analysis based on the program statement of work. She has started planning to hold sessions, conduct survey, and use focus groups among stakeholders. This approach enables Ana to:
choices: A. Create a communications management plan.
B. Identify suitable technologies for distributing program information.
C. Develop a stakeholder communications strategy.
D. Identify stakeholders' attitudes toward the program.

text: A program manager, Jack, is creating a document where he is integrating the program's subsidiary plans and establishing the overall plan for integrating and managing the program individual components. Which plan is Jack creating?

Who among the following is responsible for defining the types of changes that a program manager would be independently authorized to approve and those changes that would require further discussion before approval?

A program manager has been assigned a new development program in his organization. During the program definition phase, he has defined the cost estimates for the program components. Now, during the benefits delivery phase, he realized that his estimation was not accurate enough for one of his program components. What should be the best choice for the program manager?
choices: A. Record issue in the log for this lack of budget.
B. Generate a change request to get the required additional budget.
C. Talk regarding the issue to the component manager to find the solution.
D. De-scope some items to fit the budget.

text: Which of the following statements are true of the program schedule monitoring and controlling activity?
choices: A. Ensures that the program produces the required capabilities and benefits on time
B. Works closely with other program activities to determine schedule variances and direct corrective actions when required
C. Tracks and monitors the start and finish of all high-level component and program activities and milestones against the program roadmap planned timelines
D. Includes updates to the program master schedule and identification of schedule risks as outputs to the activity

text: Which of the following statements are true of program periodic health checks?
choices: B. Determine the program's investment against the intended benefits.
C. Progress the program towards the realization and sustainment of benefits
D. Assess the ongoing performance of the program.

text: As a program manager, Josephine, is looking for a document that provides critical information used in the development of program documentation and its ongoing alignment as the known stakeholder's change. Which of the following is the required document?

Ana is a program manager of her organization. She is working on a program that involves the installation of the wind turbine across the country. During the program delivery phase, a stakeholder raises a change request to add an additional module with the existing installation. The program steering committee has approved the change request. Which of the following statements are true regarding this scenario?
choices: A. The program master schedule is updated to reflect the changes in the program.
B. A new program master schedule document is created containing the approved changes.
C. A new program charter document is created containing the approved changes.
D. The program roadmap is upgraded to include the approved changes in the program.

text: Smith is managing a program for the next generation of parachutes for his department of the Army. In total, his program has five projects and all the work is to be done in three years. As he regularly reports on the status of the benefits of this program, he must measure the benefits that have accrued to date and communicate the information to the program sponsor and program governance board. Which of the following documents includes the metrics and procedures that Smith is using for this reporting?
In which of the following cases does the program budget become the primary financial target that the program is measured against?
choices: A. When the program plan is created
B. When the budget is baselined
C. When the budget is allocated
D. When the program charter is created

text: A program manager can use which document that provides guidance and information to aid in managing stakeholder expectations, as well as to promote stakeholder interaction and involvement?
Who is responsible for reviewing the stakeholder metrics regularly for identifying potential risks caused by a lack of participation from stakeholders?

Bob is a new program manager who has been asked to spend his maximum hours working with the stakeholders who are involved in his program. Why do you think these long working hours spent with stakeholders are valuable to the program?
choices: A. For better understanding of the change request for the program
B. For better understanding of the organizational culture and politics
C. For better understanding of the concerns related to the program
D. For better understanding of the overall impact of the program

text: Which of the following are parts of the program governance plan?
A program manager is performing the program cost estimation activity and is asked to define a confidence factor for his program. Why is the confidence factor used?
choices: A. To define the program capital cost
B. To define the estimated program cost
C. To determine the potential range of program costs
D. To define the estimated program running cost

text: Gisselle has been asked to create a communications management plan for her program. Which of the following factors should she take into account when developing this plan?

Which of the following phases of benefits management domain verifies that the integration and closure of the program and its components meet or exceed the benefit realization criteria established to achieve the strategic objectives of the program?

A pen making US-based company has thrived an advanced technology fountain pen program in joint collaboration with a multinational company. A number of business tycoons from other countries are interested in investment for this program. Who should primarily be involved in making this decision?
choices: A. Project manager based on his team recommendation
B. Program governance board and senior executives in alliance
C. Project manager based on the recommendation of the program managers
D. Program manager based on the recommendation of the project managers

text: Holly is a new program manager of the HQQ program for his organization. Bob, the project sponsor, has asked him to use SWOT analysis for the component program based on a cost overrun, but he is unaware of this analysis. As an experienced program manager, what will be your answer?
choices: A. It refers to analyzing the scope, weaknesses, opportunities, and timely risks of the program.
B. It means scope, waiting, open, and team work for the program objectives.
C. It means scope, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats for the program objectives.
D. It refers to analyzing the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of the program.

text: A program manager will perform which of the following tasks in the program scope monitoring and controlling activity?
choices: A. Direct corrective actions when required.
B. Record scope changes that are requested.
C. Communicate the decision to affected stakeholders.

text: Which of the following formally documents the activities required for obtaining the planned benefits of the program?

Which of the following documents is described in the statement given below? "It is used for collecting and listing the planned benefits for the program. It measures and communicates the delivery of benefits throughout the program's duration."

You are a senior program manager of your organization. You are performing a risk management strategy to ensure that the organizational goals and objectives are aligned with the organizational strategy. Which of the following activities should you include?
choices: A. Recognize the threats the organization faces.
B. Determine how risks will be communicated to strategic levels of the organization.
C. Develop a high-level program risk response strategy.

text: The IT company ABC has been actively working since years following the good project management principles however, the company has not executed projects based on the program management. John, from the ABC company, has recently done the PgMP certification and suggested to his supervisor that two of his current ongoing projects could be better managed and executed as a program. John's supervisor further met the executive board and collectively, they realized that along with the above two projects few more ongoing projects would be better handled through a program structure. One of the members in the executive board was well aware of the importance of governance and stage-gate reviews from his previous work experience and he recommended that all the programs should also have a governance structure. The recommended governance structure is mentioned in which of the following documents?
The program formulation and program planning subphases are parts of which of the following?
In which of the following ways do programs deliver benefits to the sponsor organizations?
choices: A. By providing a means to effectively manage a collection of investment and work
B. By offering new products and services
D. By creating or maintaining assets

text: Which document establishes the rationale behind the program requirement or proposal?

A management is asking for a document that provides authority to execute the program within a certain timeline and includes key milestone dates for the delivery of the program or incremental benefits. Which of the following is the required document?

Cheri is managing a large construction program. Stakeholders have asked her to provide a document that shows the stages of construction contribute to the final benefits of the construction. Which document will Cheri provide to the stakeholders?

Terri, a program manager, is looking for a document that describes the guidelines for making program resource prioritization decisions and resolving resource conflicts. Which of the following is the required artifact?

Sally has been recently assigned as a program manager for the C-MAX program. She has read and thoroughly understood the business case and overall goals and objectives of the program. However, she is curious about the key outcomes that are required for achieving the program vision and benefits. These key outcomes are stated in which of the following documents?
The program WBS (work breakdown structure) includes which of the following elements?
choices: B. Program management artifacts such as plans, procedures, standards, processes
D. Program management office support deliverables

text: Ana is a project manager of her organization. She is involved in preparing the closure for her component project delivered by a vendor. She has contacted the program manager to officially close out the vendor contract. According to the given scenario, when should the program manager formally close out the vendor contract?
choices: A. After making sure that the program has begun to deliver its intended benefits
B. After making sure that there are no outstanding contractual issues
C. After making sure that some of the payments have been made
D. After making sure that all deliverables have been satisfactorily completed

text: Sally, a program manager, is managing a hexacore processor development program in her company. During the delivery phase, the program team members identify several issues that force Sally to modify program requirements. Some changes were minor, but two issues require a program scope change. According to the scenario, what will be the program manager's next step?
choices: A. Update the program management plan.
B. Reassign work to the team.

text: In which phase are the high-level scope, risks, costs, and expected benefits of the program assessed to ensure that the program represents a viable way for the organization and is well aligned with the strategic objectives of the organization?
Which of the following are the program activities that support program management and governance?

John is working as a program manager in an organization. His first program will be in the area of portable financial transactions by any type of device—a phone, PDA, tablet, e-Reader, or computer. He realized that two of the projects in the program needs an expert approximately at the same time. The project managers of both of these projects have included this expert in their project management plans, resource assignment metrics, and project schedules. This is an example of which of the following?

As a program manager, you have been asked to create the reporting and controlling documents for monitoring program's progress and strengthening the organization's ability to assess program status and conformance with organizational controls. What will you include in the documents?
choices: A. Known program risks, their response plans, and escalation criteria
B. Potential profits, social needs, and environmental influences
C. Program funding and financial performance
D. Expected or incurred program resource requirements

text: Ryan is a program manager in XYZ Inc. He has started working in a new program. The area to be addressed by the program is understood, and the stakeholders with whom communication should be established are identified. What is the next step that Ryan should take?
Who is the program champion and provides resources and support for the program?
For securing program funding from external sources, who is typically responsible for entering into the appropriate agreements necessary to secure it?
The program is closed for which of the following reasons?
choices: A. When the desired benefits are met
B. When any change requests arise
C. When measurements against the program's key performance indicators reveal that the business case for the program is no longer viable
D. When the benefits and objectives to be achieved by the program are no longer in alignment with the organization's strategy

text: Kate was assigned a new program in the TYK organization. The organization has its predefined approaches to risk management that can be used by Kate in her program. Which of the following can be considered part of this approach?
choices: B. Common definition of concepts and terms
D. Authority levels for decision making

text: When does a program steering committee request for a decision-point review?
choices: A. When there is a need to add governance structures for monitoring and managing the program component
B. When there is a need to review the stakeholder satisfaction with the current program performance
C. When they need to compare the strategic alignment of the program with the intended goals of both the program and the organization
D. When there is a need to assess the potential impact of external (environmental) developments on program strategies and plans

text: Who provides professional expertise using staff, highly trained in applying program governance practices for providing oversight, support, and decision-making capability to the program?
A business case is developed for determining the program's investment against the intended benefits. Which stakeholder should be the best suitable to approve the program business case?

Jerry is assigned a task to execute one critical program in an organization. He is trying to convince the portfolio management body to authorize his program. Which of the following artifacts should Jerry present?
Jim is assigned to manage a program for the first time. He is confused about the purpose of defining a program vision. Which of the following statements can help him?
choices: A. The vision statement is used to align the objectives and intended benefits of the program with the organization strategic objectives.
B. The vision statement is not necessary as many programs succeeded without having a vision statement created.
C. The vision statement describes the purpose of the program, articulating the reason the program exists.
D. The vision statement is used as a constant reminder of the objectives and intended benefits of the program.

text: Joseph is a program manager of his organization. He is required to create a document for his new development program. While document creation, he tried to get answers to the following questions: What are the key outcomes required to achieve the program vision and benefits? Why is the program important and what does it achieve? What is the approach to ensure the realization of the planned benefits? What is the total length of the program, including all key milestone dates Which of the following documents is Joseph working on?

Lisa is a program manager assigned to a new program in her organization. She is collecting information about the program benefits, mapping the planned benefits to the program components, and describing how each benefit will be measured in the program. Which artifact is Lisa creating?
The sources of complexity within programs and projects can be grouped into which of the following?

Which document provides authority to the program manager for directing other subsidiary programs, projects, and related activities to be initiated, along with the framework that manages and monitors these program components during the course of the program?
A risk response in a program has actually caused new risks. What term is assigned to the new risks that a risk response has created?

Vienna is a program manager of an organization. Her organization is launching new versions of electronic appliances and she is given the responsibility for managing this program. What is the best way for Vienna to get clear requirements?
choices: A. Interviews with customers to determine their requirements
B. Questionnaires sent to existing customers
C. Suggestions from experts in the appliance industry
D. Observations and historical records of feedback from customers

text: Jack is working in an organization where he is managing the M-Tel program. He is responsible for management and oversight of the interactions of the program with the program governance function. He is also making decisions on behalf of the program steering committee. Jack is performing the responsibilities of which of the following?

You're helping John, a new program manager in your organization. John wants to know why anyone can't just launch a program. He has a question as to what document in the organization authorizes a program to exist. What document does your organization use to formally authorize a program?

As a program manager, you are looking for a document that describes the overall expected benefits to be addressed by the program in support of the strategic initiatives. Which of the following is the required document?
A power/interest grid model used for stakeholder analysis categorizes stakeholders based on which of the following?
Which of the following domains enables and performs program decision making, establishes practices to support the program, and maintain program oversight?

Alice is a program manager for his organization. He has been assigned a four years' program for building a bridge. Alice assignment has started in the third year of the program. After he joined this program, he reviewed the program benefits register and discovered that the benefits are realized only at the end of the program. What should Alice do?
choices: A. Set up a meeting with the program steering committee to review the approved program governance plan.
B. Continue with his assignment as it is regular for large public work programs to realize the benefits at the end of the program.
C. Discuss with the program team to review the benefits register.

text: Which of the following activities of program risk management are in the program delivery phase?
choices: D. Program risk monitoring and controlling

text: A program manager is in the program closure phase and is required to create a final program report document. Which of the following items will the program manager include in this document?
choices: C. Contingency plans and trigger conditions

Her analysis focuses on the return on investment for new software that may be created if the program is initiated. What type of document is Ana likely creating for her company?

A program manager is working on a complex program and wants to use an artifact that visually represents the interaction of all stakeholders' current and desired support and influence. Which of the following will help in accomplishing it?
Which of the following are the roles of a program manager in program stakeholder communications?
choices: A. To continually monitor changes and update stakeholder engagement activities and deliverables as required
B. To constantly monitor and foster an environment where stakeholder communication needs are met
C. To create a strategy for each stakeholder as recognized in the stakeholder register
D. To actively engage stakeholders only the program's delivery phase

text: Which of the following statements describe a portfolio?
choices: A. A portfolio describes the organization of related projects, programs, and operations.
B. A portfolio is a group of related projects that are managed together using coordinated processes and techniques.
C. A portfolio defines and manages the program-related governance processes, procedures, and templates.

text: Which of the following are examples of intangible elements?

You are a program manager of your organization. Your program team has finished the third phase of a seven-phase program. At the end of each phase, management reviews the work your program team has completed and determines if the program should be allowed to continue. What name describes this type of review?

Maria is a program manager of her organization. She is creating a WBS (work breakdown structure) of a program where she is showing how each component contributes to the program objectives. Which of the following program management activities is the program manager performing?
Jack is a member of the program steering committee. What are his responsibilities?
choices: A. Endorsing or approving program recommendations and changes
B. Ensuring that all stakeholders are adequately and appropriately engaged
C. Conducting planning sessions to confirm, prioritize, and fund the program
D. Reviewing expected benefits and benefits delivery

text: Sally is a program manager of the ABC program for her organization. She has reviewed some of the program activities and analyzed that her team will not be able to complete the activities as they may have not the expertise to accomplish and can give rise to risk if it is managed by the team. She allotted the program activities to another team who is ready to take on the work and perform the job. According to the scenario, Andy will perform which of the following to identify and assess the reasons for nonparticipation of active stakeholders?
Jack, a program manager, is performing the program quality control activity. The outputs of this activity include which of the following?

Joseph is a newly assigned program manager in your organization. He is trying to understand the main purpose of the program governance plan. He came to you for help. As an experienced program manager, what will you respond?
choices: A. Describe the structure, goals, roles, responsibilities, policies, procedures, and logistics for executing the governance process.
B. Guide the program manager to develop the rest of the program management plans.
C. Define the way that the steering committee will guide the program.
D. Guide the program sponsor to provide resources and support for the program.

text: As a program manager, you are finally in the program closure phase. As part of this phase, you are currently documenting important information that can be applied for enhancing the success of future programs and component projects. In which document does the program manager working on?

A program manager, Ana, is currently monitoring the organizational environment (including internal and external factors), program objectives, and benefits realization to make sure that the program remains aligned with the organization's strategic objectives. With respect to the benefits management domain, in which phase is she working?

Andrew, a program manager, is working on a program, which was set up with eight separate projects. Since each project in this program has inter-relationships with other projects in terms of the benefits to be delivered, he decided one best practice to follow was to track the benefits described in his benefits management plan in a benefits register and make this register visible not only to his entire team but also to his client organization. He felt such a benefits register would help track the benefits accrued by the eight projects, thus enabling his organization to realize and sustain all the benefits of its investment in the program. When does this register end in terms of the program benefits management life cycle?
choices: A. When benefits planning is completed
B. When the positive and negative risks to benefits are updated
C. When the program is terminated
D. When benefits are mapped to the program components

text: Giselle has been assigned as a program manager for executing a critical program in her organization. The program infrastructure includes a quality manager who was appointed by the program steering committee. While conducting a meeting with Giselle's team members for developing a program resource management plan, the quality manager requested her to attend the meeting for verifying that quality activities and controls are applied in the program planning phase. What should Giselle do?
choices: A. Ask the quality manager to concentrate on the deliverables and services, and not on the program management activities.
B. Speak to the steering committee to let the quality manager concentrate on his/her job only.

text: Alice is in the program planning phase of his ABC program. He is currently decomposing his program work into deliverable components for delivering the associated benefits. What activity is Alice executing?

A program manager along with the component managers created a resource management plan. During the program delivery phase, the necessity for resources changed. How should the program manager prioritize the resource requirements within the program?
choices: A. A program manager should discuss with his component managers for resource conflict and add new issue to the register.

text: When is the program governance plan referenced for ensuring that the program is conforming to established governance expectations and agreements?
choices: A. At the program formulation sub-phase
B. At the program delivery phase
C. At the program definition phase
D. Throughout the program life cycle

She is defining the degree of support or opposition to the program benefits, attitudes about the program and its sponsors, the expectation of program benefits delivery, and the ability to influence the outcome of the program for each stakeholder. Which program artifact is Josephine creating?
Which of the following domains includes the policies, procedures, and processes used for reviewing the program, analyzing the results, and making decisions about the program?
Changes in scope have a significant impact on a component or the program and may originate from which of the following?

Jack's suggestion to the city government to combine projects into programs in the regulations and standards area has been well received. choices: A. Understanding the resource requirements for the delivery of benefits expected of the program
